verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no import or migration feature. Only indirect paths exist: syncing Trello with Jira, rich APIs that could support scripted imports, and Marketplace apps that may include importers. Taken together this is a thin, workaround-level fit for switching tools. Missing for 10: a documented native importer (e.g. CSV or competitor-specific migration), coverage of tools beyond Trello, field/history mapping details, and hands-on corroboration of a migration.
